title: North-West London is leading the UK’s new industrial revolution
summary:

title: Property Franchise Group reports 7% revenue growth
summary:
The Property Franchise Group has posted a 7% annual increase in revenue to £43.3 million for the six months ending 30 June 2026. Pre-tax profits rose 7% to £15.5 million during the period, with franchising revenue up 8% and financial services revenue increasing 10%.

title: Property franchise group posts 7% revenue rise in H1 2026
summary:
The Property Franchise Group has reported a 7% increase in revenue to £43.3m for the first half of 2026, despite subdued property sales market conditions. The AIM-listed group, which owns estate agency brands including Belvoir and Martin & Co, posted adjusted pre-tax profit of £15.5m and increased its interim dividend by 10%.

title: Welsh HMO conversion secures £52k refurbishment funding
summary:
A mid-terraced property in Wales has been converted from a three-bedroom dwelling into a four-bedroom house in multiple occupation using a two-stage financing structure from a single lender. The borrower acquired the property for £85,000 and subsequently drew £52,000 in refurbishment funding at 75% loan-to-value.

title: Rent arrears affect 26% of landlords in past year
summary:
More than one in four landlords have experienced rent arrears in the past year, according to new research from Pegasus Insight. The 26% figure represents a decline from 42% recorded at the peak in 2020, though void periods remain a persistent challenge across the sector.

title: UK mortgage approvals rise 11% in second quarter
summary:
UK mortgage approvals totalled £77.4 billion in the second quarter of 2026, representing an 11% increase on the first three months of the year. The share of high loan-to-value lending reached its highest level since 2008.

title: Estate agents using Street CRM report 24% instruction rise
summary:
Estate agents using Street.co.uk's CRM tools for two years or more have recorded a 24% average increase in instruction volumes compared with competitors, according to analysis by the software provider. Properties marketed through the platform were also 23% more likely to reach sold subject to contract status.

title: Lender provides £4.5m for London buy-to-let properties
summary:
Butterfield Mortgages Limited has completed a £4.5 million financing deal for the acquisition of two central London buy-to-let properties valued at £7 million. The transaction was structured through a holding company and two special purpose vehicles at 65% loan-to-value.

title: Shawbrook backs £7.5m Essex development with planning changes
summary:
Shawbrook has completed a £7.5m development finance facility for a ten-unit residential scheme in Shenfield, Essex, which secured planning enhancements during construction that increased its scope and value. The Birley Grange development carried a gross development value of approximately £11.5m.

title: Mixed-use Hertfordshire site secures £1.25m finance
summary:
A 50-acre mixed-use site near Hitchin, Hertfordshire, has been acquired for £1.8 million with a £1.25 million acquisition facility from MERA. The former commercial glasshouse site includes two bungalows, five acres of glasshouses, and approximately 40 acres of farmland.
